"""Independent frozen-media delivery checks; no model or production-code edits."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/assets/readme-20261016'


def sha(p):
    return 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(p, d):
    p.write_text(json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def decode(path, media):
    tail = ['-map', '0:v:0', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb24'] if media == 'video' else ['-map', '0:a:0', '-f', 'f32le', '-ac', '2', '-ar', '48000']
    result = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-i', str(path), *tail, 'pipe:1'], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=60)
    return np.frombuffer(result.stdout, np.uint8).reshape(-1, 360, 640, 3) if media == 'video' else np.frombuffer(result.stdout, '<f4').reshape(-1, 2)


verification = json.loads((OUT/'verification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for name, record in verification['files'].items():
    assert sha(OUT/name) == record['sha256'] and (OUT/name).stat().st_size == record['bytes'], name
assert len(verification['cli_calls']) == 14
assert all(c['result']['ok'] and c['result']['status'] == 'succeeded' for c in verification['cli_calls'])
assert verification['quality']['ok'] and verification['policy']['ok']
assert verification['render_warning_count'] == 0
assert verification['generator_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'scripts/build_readme_gallery.py')
baseline = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/validation/evidence/repair-blend-smoke-20261016.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert len(baseline['implementation_sha256']) == 89
assert all(sha(ROOT/name) == digest for name, digest in baseline['implementation_sha256'].items())
frames = decode(OUT/'cli-showcase.mp4', 'video').astype(np.float32)
assert frames.shape == (165, 360, 640, 3)
observations = {}
for index in [15, 30, 45, 60, 65, 83, 135]:
    a = frames[index, 70:296]
    cyan = (a[:, :, 1]-a[:, :, 0] > 60) & (a[:, :, 2]-a[:, :, 0] > 60) & (np.indices(a.shape[:2])[1] < 430)
    warm = (a[:, :, 0]-a[:, :, 1] > 20) & (a[:, :, 0]-a[:, :, 2] > 20)
    y, x = np.where(cyan)
    yw, xw = np.where(warm)
    observations[str(index)] = {'cyan_pixels': len(x), 'cyan_bbox': [int(x.min()), int(x.max()), int(y.min()+70), int(y.max()+70)] if len(x) else None,
                                'warm_pixels': len(xw), 'warm_centroid_x': float(xw.mean()) if len(xw) else None}
assert observations['60']['cyan_bbox'][1]-observations['60']['cyan_bbox'][0] > observations['15']['cyan_bbox'][1]-observations['15']['cyan_bbox'][0]
assert observations['65']['warm_centroid_x']-observations['30']['warm_centroid_x'] > 40
assert observations['135']['cyan_pixels'] == 0 and observations['135']['warm_pixels'] > 20000
audio = decode(OUT/'cli-showcase.mp4', 'audio')
source = decode(OUT/'source-audio.wav', 'audio')
a, b = source[48000:192000, 0], audio[48000:192000, 0]
correlation = float(np.corrcoef(a, b)[0, 1])
gain = float(np.dot(a, b)/np.dot(a, a))
assert correlation > .999 and abs(gain-.8) < .01
manual = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'reviewer': 'assistant-image-inspection',
          'method': 'local view_image of contact PNGs at original resolution; sampled frames only',
          'files': {name: sha(OUT/name) for name in ['cli-contact.png', 'translation-contact.png', 'two-surfaces-contact.png']},
          'cli_sampled_frames': [15, 45, 83, 135], 'research_sampled_frames': {'translation': [6], 'two-surfaces': [6]},
          'findings': ['Product: scaled procedural bottle, feathered overlay, blended transition and later ring scene visible; raster title layers visible.',
                       'Translation: magenta input, gray fallback and texture reconstruction differences visible against truth.',
                       'Two surfaces: residual texture/patch differences remain; preserve the slight combined PSNR regression.'],
          'continuous_playback_reviewed': False, 'human_listening_completed': False,
          'natural_media_published': False, 'broad_quality_accepted': False}
write(OUT/'manual-review.json', manual)
collector = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
write(ROOT/'docs/validation/evidence/readme-gallery-20261016.json', {
    'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'status': 'functional-demo-delivered-broad-quality-unaccepted',
    'base_commit': verification['base_commit'], 'verification_sha256': sha(OUT/'verification.json'),
    'generator_sha256': sha(ROOT/'scripts/build_readme_gallery.py'), 'manual_review_sha256': sha(OUT/'manual-review.json'),
    'frozen_files_verified': len(verification['files']), 'successful_cli_calls': 14,
    'baseline_363_source_files_verified': 89, 'full_product_regression_rerun': False, 'research_checks_rerun': False,
    'baseline_source_comparison': verification['baseline_source_comparison'],
    'line_ending_source_comparison_checks': json.loads((ROOT/'product/.runtime/readme_source_comparison_20261016.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')),
    'all_seven_mp4_decoded_by_generator': True, 'three_gif_frames_and_timing_checked_by_generator': True,
    'independent_output_decode_frames': len(frames), 'decoded_pixel_observations': observations,
    'pixel_check_scope': 'procedural composite color regions only; not isolated per-effect equivalence or natural-video accuracy',
    'audio_check': {'decoded_aac_samples_per_channel': len(audio), 'original_pcm_samples_per_channel': len(source),
                    'comparison_seconds': [1, 4], 'left_channel_correlation': correlation, 'left_channel_gain': gain,
                    'requested_gain': .8, 'sample_padding_note': 'AAC decode returns 192 padded samples; declared stream duration is 264000/48000=5.5s',
                    'scope': 'middle-window generated tone chain; not human listening, voice quality or sample-exact audio pass-through'},
    'files': {p.name: {'sha256': sha(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size} for p in sorted(OUT.iterdir()) if p.is_file()},
    'collector_source': collector, 'collector_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
    'natural_visual_quality_accepted': False, 'full_jianying_parity_accepted': False,
})
print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'successful_cli_calls': 14, 'baseline_files': 89,
                  'audio_correlation': correlation, 'audio_gain': gain, 'gallery_files': len(list(OUT.iterdir()))}))
